context: A teacher reflects on her career with a former student
purpose: Teach: 警備/中継/看護/録画/残す/時には/次第に/観る

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、お久しぶりです。卒業式の録画、今でも大切に残してあります。
lines.en: Sensei, it's been a while. I still carefully keep the recording of our graduation ceremony.
lines.style: Warm, slightly nostalgic, polite tone from a former student reconnecting.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あら、桜ちゃん。あの映像をずっと残してくれていたのね。嬉しいわ。
lines.en: Oh my, Sakura. You've kept that footage all this time? That makes me happy.
lines.style: Soft, motherly, genuinely touched teacher voice with reflective warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生は最初、看護の道に進みたかったって聞きました。本当ですか?
lines.en: I heard you originally wanted to pursue a career in nursing. Is that true?
lines.style: Curious, gentle, slightly leaning-forward tone of respectful inquiry.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、本当よ。でも教育実習で子供たちに会って、気持ちが次第に変わっていったの。
lines.en: Yes, that's right. But meeting the children during my teaching practicum gradually changed my heart.
lines.style: Reflective, slow-paced, sharing a meaningful life turning point softly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 時には厳しかったですけど、運動会の警備をしてくださった姿、よく覚えてます。
lines.en: You were strict at times, but I remember you handling security duty at sports day.
lines.style: Affectionate teasing mixed with sincere admiration, teenage warmth showing through.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あの日ね、地元テレビの中継まで入って、本当に緊張したのよ。
lines.en: That day, even the local TV broadcast came to cover it. I was so nervous.
lines.style: Light laugh, embarrassed reminiscence, recalling a vivid pressured memory.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今でもその録画を観ると、先生の若い頃の声が聞こえてきます。
lines.en: Even now, when I watch that recording, I can hear your younger voice.
lines.style: Tender, soft-spoken, sentimental delivery from a grown-up former student.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう言ってくれてありがとう。先生でいられて、本当によかったわ。
lines.en: Thank you for saying that. I'm truly glad I got to be your teacher.
lines.style: Emotional, slightly trembling, deeply heartfelt closing reflection.
